title: A west-coast day on Phu Quoc
summary: Start on Bãi Trường for the swim and the sunset, and ride to Bãi Sao for the southeast swim. The road from the centre of Dương Đông takes about 25 minutes.

stops.name: Long Beach
stops.note: Swim and walk the west-coast sand, and stay for sunset over the Gulf.

stops.name: Sao Beach

approach.note: From the centre of Dương Đông.

stops.note: Swim the southeast shallows, and come early on a weekday.

seoTitle: A west-coast day on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: One day on Phu Quoc: Bãi Trường for the swim and the sunset, then Bãi Sao, about 25 minutes by road from Dương Đông.
